title: The person already changed the document
task: Move the whole weekend one day later.

setup.text: Friday: leave by 3 pm after school pickup, then groceries in Issaquah

checks.description: The agent reads the document before it edits anything, so it sees the person's own change.
Every id the agent passes to an edit came from a result it was given.
The person's own detail survives the move.
Every day moves one day later (Friday to Saturday, Saturday to Sunday, Sunday to Monday), including in the opening paragraph, and the person's own change about school pickup is kept.

source.basis: The person edits too. An agent that works from a stale picture overwrites what they did.
